description_en: Retrieves the basic information of images by using paging and a paged query, including the image name, type, status, and version identity
description_zh: 分页查询镜像基础信息，包括镜像名称、类型、状态和版本标识
name: ListImageBaseInfo

parameters.help_en: The image ID. You can specify multiple IDs separated by commas (,). The query matches any of the specified IDs
parameters.help_zh: 镜像 ID。支持传入多个 ID，使用半角逗号（,）分隔；多个 ID 之间按任一匹配查询
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The image query keyword. Fuzzy matching is performed on both the image name and the image ID
parameters.help_zh: 镜像查询关键字。同时对镜像名称和镜像 ID 进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The image status. Valid values: INIT (initialization), CREATING (creating), AVAILABLE (available), and CREATE_FAILED (creation failed). If you do not specify this parameter, all non-deleted images are queried. Deleted images are not returned
parameters.help_zh: 镜像状态。支持 INIT（初始化）、CREATING（创建中）、AVAILABLE（可用）、CREATE_FAILED（创建失败）。不传时查询所有未删除状态的镜像；已删除的镜像不返回
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The image type. Valid values: System (system image), User (custom image), Shared (shared image), and Community (community image)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像类型。支持 System（系统镜像）、User（自定义镜像）、Shared（共享镜像）、Community（社区镜像）
parameters.name: image_type

parameters.help_en: The image package type. Valid values: Ecs (ECS image), Vhd (VHD image), Container (container image), Ecs_Container (ECS and container composite image), and K8s_Node (Kubernetes node image)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像封装类型。支持 Ecs（ECS 镜像）、Vhd（VHD 镜像）、Container（容器镜像）、Ecs_Container（ECS 与容器组合镜像）、K8s_Node（Kubernetes 节点镜像）
parameters.name: package_type

parameters.help_en: The image operating system type. Valid values: Windows (Windows operating system), Linux (Linux operating system), Android (Android operating system), and Unknown (unknown operating system)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像操作系统类型。支持 Windows（Windows 操作系统）、Linux（Linux 操作系统）、Android（Android 操作系统）、Unknown（未知操作系统）
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The business line code. Default value: 1
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The product type, which is used to filter the products to which the images belong. Examples: CloudDesktop (WUYING Workspace), CloudApp (WUYING Cloud App), and WuyingServer (WUYING Workstation)
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型，用于筛选镜像所属产品。例如 CloudDesktop（无影云电脑）、CloudApp（无影云应用）、WuyingServer（无影工作站）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The image protocol type. Valid values: ASP (Alibaba Cloud self-developed ASP protocol) and HDX (HDX protocol)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像协议类型。支持 ASP（阿里云自研 ASP 协议）和 HDX（HDX 协议）
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. If the value is less than 1, 10 entries are returned. If the value is greater than 100, 100 entries are returned
parameters.help_zh: 每页查询的记录数。默认值为 10，最大值为 100。小于 1 时按 10 查询，大于 100 时按 100 查询
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. If you do not specify this parameter or specify a value less than 1, the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从 1 开始。不传或小于 1 时查询第一页
parameters.name: page_number

schema.description_en: The paging results of the paged query for the basic image information
schema.description_zh: 镜像基础信息的分页查询结果

Code.description_en: The result code of the request

Count.description_en: The total number of images that meet the query conditions
Count.description_zh: 符合查询条件的镜像总数

Data.description_en: The list of basic image information on the current page
Data.description_zh: 当前页的镜像基础信息列表

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the image belongs. A value of 0 indicates a system image
AliUid.description_zh: 镜像所属的阿里云账号 ID。值为 0 时表示系统镜像

BizType.description_en: The business line code of the image, which corresponds to the BizType request parameter
BizType.description_zh: 镜像所属的业务线编码，对应请求参数 BizType

Distro.description_en: The distribution name of the image operating system
Distro.description_zh: 镜像操作系统的发行版名称

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the image was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
GmtCreate.description_zh: 镜像创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the image was last updated. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
GmtModified.description_zh: 镜像最后更新时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

ImageId.description_en: The image ID. The ID of a custom image is generated by the system
ImageId.description_zh: 镜像 ID。自定义镜像的 ID 由系统生成
ImageId.title_en: 系统镜像id有含义，自定义镜像自动生成
ImageId.title_zh: 系统镜像id有含义，自定义镜像自动生成

ImageType.description_en: The image type. A value of System indicates a system image, User indicates a custom image, Shared indicates a shared image, and Community indicates a community image
ImageType.description_zh: 镜像类型。System 表示系统镜像，User 表示自定义镜像，Shared 表示共享镜像，Community 表示社区镜像

LatestVersionId.description_en: The ID of the latest sub-version of the image
LatestVersionId.description_zh: 该镜像最新子版本的 ID

OnlineVersionId.description_en: The ID of the sub-version currently used to read the main image information for this image
OnlineVersionId.description_zh: 该镜像当前用于读取主镜像信息的子版本 ID

OsType.description_en: The image operating system type. A value of Windows indicates the Windows operating system, Linux indicates the Linux operating system, Android indicates the Android operating system, and Unknown indicates an unknown operating system
OsType.description_zh: 镜像操作系统类型。Windows 表示 Windows 操作系统，Linux 表示 Linux 操作系统，Android 表示 Android 操作系统，Unknown 表示未知操作系统

PackageType.description_en: The image package type. A value of Ecs indicates an ECS image, Vhd indicates a VHD image, Container indicates a container image, Ecs_Container indicates an ECS and container composite image, and K8s_Node indicates a Kubernetes node image
PackageType.description_zh: 镜像封装类型。Ecs 表示 ECS 镜像，Vhd 表示 VHD 镜像，Container 表示容器镜像，Ecs_Container 表示 ECS 与容器组合镜像，K8s_Node 表示 Kubernetes 节点镜像

ProductType.description_en: The product type to which the image belongs. Examples: CloudDesktop (WUYING Workspace), CloudApp (WUYING Cloud App), and WuyingServer (WUYING Workstation)
ProductType.description_zh: 镜像所属的产品类型，例如 CloudDesktop（无影云电脑）、CloudApp（无影云应用）、WuyingServer（无影工作站）

ProtocolType.description_en: The image protocol type. A value of ASP indicates the Alibaba Cloud self-developed ASP protocol, and HDX indicates the HDX protocol
ProtocolType.description_zh: 镜像协议类型。ASP 表示阿里云自研 ASP 协议，HDX 表示 HDX 协议

Status.description_en: The image status. A value of INIT indicates initialization, CREATING indicates creating, AVAILABLE indicates available, and CREATE_FAILED indicates creation failed
Status.description_zh: 镜像状态。INIT 表示初始化，CREATING 表示创建中，AVAILABLE 表示可用，CREATE_FAILED 表示创建失败

Message.description_en: The result message of the request

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 请求指定的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
